items.title: Angeli Earns Manning Award Star of the Week
items.summary: After leading the Syracuse football team back from a 15-point deficit in the final minutes at NC State, quarterback Steve Angeli has been named one of the Manning Award Stars of the Week, the Allstate Sugar Bowl announced Monday.

items.title: Orange Set to Battle Boston College Saturday
items.summary: Syracuse is set to play its final road game of the regular season on Saturday afternoon when it travels to Chestnut Hill, Mass., to face Boston College. The game is slated for a noon kickoff and will air on ACC Network.

items.title: Adeleye, Russell III Earn ACC Player of the Week Nods
items.summary: Two Syracuse standouts earned conference recognition this week. Wide receiver Calvin Russell III was named both ACC Offensive Receiver of the Week and ACC Rookie of the Week, while defensive lineman Tunmise Adeleye was tabbed ACC Defensive Lineman of the Week.

items.title: Hatcher Named Biletnikoff Award Semifinalist
items.summary: Syracuse wide receiver Umari Hatcher has been named one of 13 semifinalists for the Biletnikoff Award, presented annually to the nation's most outstanding receiver.

items.title: Orange Storm Back for Road Win over NC State
items.summary: Syracuse mounted a 15-point fourth-quarter comeback to defeat NC State, 34-31, in Raleigh on Saturday afternoon.
